# YVR Garage Door Springs

> Emergency garage door spring repair across Greater Vancouver. Local technicians living in each of the 16 cities we serve — typically 12 minutes from your home. One service, three flat-rate tiers, no diagnostic fee, no after-hours surcharge. Quoted price = paid price.

## What we do

We replace broken residential garage door springs (torsion and extension). One service, done right, same day in most cases. We don't sell new doors, openers, or panels — just springs and the cables that work with them.

## Service area

We serve 16 Greater Vancouver cities: Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, New Westminster, Delta, Langley, White Rock, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Tsawwassen.

Each city has a local technician living in that community. Average drive time to your door: ~12 minutes.

## Pricing (flat-rate, all-in, plus GST/PST)

- One Spring — $784. Rare. Other spring stays old. Cables not replaced.
- Two Springs (95% pick this) — $832. 5-year parts. 2-year labour. Cables included free. 10,000-cycle springs.
- Two High-Cycle Springs — $1,193. 25,000-cycle springs. Sealed bearings. 7-year parts. 2-year labour.

Same price 7 a.m. or 9 p.m. Tuesday or Saturday. No after-hours rate. No diagnostic fee. No surcharges on-site.
